spec_role: Brings the Staff 360 surface (frontend/src/app/(admin)/hr/staff/[id]) under the ratified Apple design language and repairs its data truth, mirroring the Student 360 treatment for the teacher-first use case. Three deliverables: Apple HIG redesign of the entire staff profile; a real identity avatar (photo with monogram fallback and an upload path) replacing the monogram-only header; and a view-frequency tab architecture with an instant glance strip for admin, HR, and principal. Includes closing the design-guard hole that let this surface escape the AD-L5 sweep and the AD-L6 CI guards.

intent: Staff 360 is the surface a school opens to answer staff questions: payroll, leaves, probation, allocations, and the offboarding decision that must never be taken on invented numbers. The codebase analysis shows the surface never received the Apple migration and carries three defect classes. First, fabricated truth, the series' defining defect, now on payroll: when salaryBreakdown is absent the client constructs a salary structure in the browser, computing gross as basic multiplied by 1.35, PF at a hardcoded 12 percent, and professional tax hardcoded at ₹200, then renders these estimates as 'Gross Monthly Pay' and 'Net Monthly Take-Home' with no estimate label; an HR decision taken on that screen is taken on fiction. Second, the surface is the last pre-Apple island: gray-50/gray-900 chrome, indigo as the interactive tint against the ratified apple.blue law, emerald/rose/amber/purple badges from banned palettes, underline tabs against the segmented-control grammar, and an action row with three filled colored buttons at once; it demonstrably escaped both the AD-L5 sweep and the AD-L6 guards, which means the guards have a hole that must be found and closed. Third, the experience gaps the user named: monogram-only identity with no photo system, no upload path, no glance layer for instant view, and no allocation of its five flat tabs by how often anyone actually opens them. The spec applies the same treatment Student 360 received: truth first, the shared Avatar, the glance strip, frequency-allocated tabs in the segmented grammar, the whole file on the ratified design language, and mechanical tests that make the regressions impossible.

verified_facts: Surface location: frontend/src/app/(admin)/hr/staff/[id]/ with page.tsx (1,131 bytes, server component) and Staff360Client.tsx (58,929 bytes, single client component rendering the entire experience).

ACCESS MODEL VERIFIED: requireAuth([SUPER_ADMIN, SCHOOL_ADMIN, HR_MANAGER, PRINCIPAL]); other roles get no route at all. Client-side authority: canAdminister includes PRINCIPAL (can open the offboard modal and reactivate), canMutate = SUPER_ADMIN, SCHOOL_ADMIN, HR_MANAGER (edit profile, probation), Legal Hold buttons restricted to SUPER_ADMIN and SCHOOL_ADMIN. Any redesign must preserve exactly this matrix.

FABRICATED PAYROLL VERIFIED IN CODE: the compensation tab, when profile.salaryConfigured is false but salaryComponents exist, constructs b = { grossEarnings: basic * 1.35, pfEmployeeAmount: basic * 0.12, pfEmployeePercent: 12, ptAmount: 200, netMonthlyPay: basic * 1.35 - (basic * 0.12 + 200 + tds) } and renders it as 'Gross Monthly Pay', 'Statutory Deductions', and 'Net Monthly Take-Home'. Professional tax hardcoded at ₹200 for every employee in India regardless of state slab; PF universalized at 12 percent; DA and HRA derived by ad-hoc percentages. None of it is labeled an estimate. Payroll engines exist in the repo (hr/payroll, EPFO payroll ECR exports landed earlier); this client-side fiction bypasses them.

DESIGN-LANGUAGE ESCAPE VERIFIED: the file uses bg-gray-50/dark:bg-gray-950 surfaces, white cards, border-gray chrome, indigo-600 as interactive tint (active tab underline, links, focus rings, Save Profile button), and emerald/rose/amber/purple badge palettes, every one banned by the AD color law (BR-AD-2, BR-AD-3, BR-AD-4 and the CI guards from AD-L6). This surface shipped after AD-L7, so the guard has a coverage hole: L0 must determine why (scan scope, allowlist, or filename pattern) and close it mechanically.

ONE-TINT LAW VIOLATION VERIFIED: the action bar renders Edit Profile (white bordered), Confirm Probation (amber-600 filled), Offboard Staff (rose-600 filled), Reactivate Staff (emerald-600 filled), and Legal Hold toggle, conditionally up to three filled colored buttons in one row.

GOVERNANCE STYLE VERIFIED: lifecycle actions (probation confirm, offboard, legal hold, reactivate) run on window.confirm and alert(); the shared ConfirmDialog and AppModal components exist in components/ui and are the ratified pattern.

IDENTITY VERIFIED: identity renders getAvatarColor(profile.fullName) plus getInitials at 48px; no photo support for staff, no upload or replace path on the surface; employeeCode, Teaching/Non-Teaching, Legal Hold, Active/Separated, Probation badges are hand-styled spans, not the StatusBadge vocabulary.

TAB STRUCTURE VERIFIED: five flat tabs (overview: Overview & Identity, employment: Employment & Lifecycle, academics: Academic Allocations, compensation: Compensation & Loans, leaves: Leave Summary) with border-b underline style and ?tab= deep linking already implemented. Employment history, PII reveal (revealStaffPii with audit reason HR_AUDIT_360_VIEW), loans count, leave balances data all present.

ACADEMICS DATA VERIFIED: academicAllocations carries classTeacherOf list, classSubjects list, weeklyPeriodsCount; the tab handles non-teaching staff and empty allocations honestly already; this data becomes the glance strip's core for teaching staff.

STUDENT 360 PRECEDENT LANDED: the S360 spec pattern (L0 forensic baseline, truth fixes, shared Avatar component in components/ui, glance strip with NextBestAction, frequency-allocated tabs in the segmented grammar, mechanical truth and permission tests, CI guard closure) is the template; the Avatar component it created is the reuse path for staff photos.
honest_caveats: Staff360Client.tsx was read in full and its defects are code-verified, but getStaff360 in actions.ts (87,477 bytes) was not line-audited; what profile fields exist beyond those the client consumes is UNKNOWN until L0.

Whether a staff photo field exists in the schema at all (staff.photoS3Key or equivalent) is UNKNOWN at spec time; students have photoS3Key. L0 must check the schema; if no staff photo capability exists, this spec adds the field via one minimal migration (explicitly authorized) or defers photo upload to one layer if the migration proves larger than forecast, with the monogram as the honest interim identity. Photo display composes the existing signed-URL flow either way.

Whether the AD-L6 guard scanned class names or only hex values, and what its allowlist contains, is not verified; L0 reads the guard and closes the hole either way. Closing the hole may tighten the guard for other files that escaped; any such tightening is tagged in the commit body.
The teacher's own self-view lives in the teacher PWA (profile route) and is out of scope; this spec is the admin-side Teacher 360.

view_frequency_allocation.rule: Sub-modules are positioned by how often their viewer actually opens them, per the user's requirement for instant view at a glance. Staff 360's audiences are SCHOOL_ADMIN, HR_MANAGER, and PRINCIPAL. The allocation below is the proposal; the L0 matrix with the operator's approval is the record. The teacher themself is not an audience here (their self-view is the teacher PWA profile).
instant_view_glance: Identity with avatar, employee code, designation, department, status badges (StatusBadge vocabulary)
For teaching staff: class-teacher sections, subject count, weekly periods (from academicAllocations, these three numbers are the teacher's shape in the school)
Employment standing: active, probation, separated (semantic, never fabricated)
Leave balance summary for the session (used / remaining headline numbers)
Attention items: probation pending confirmation, legal hold active, active loans count, unconfirmed allocations
Next best action (compose the existing NextBestAction component): confirm probation, complete missing qualification data, pending payroll configuration
often_viewed_tier_tabs: Academic Allocations (teaching staff's most-visited view; class subjects list, class-teacher sections, timetable counts)
Employment & Lifecycle (org role, milestones, separation record)
rarely_viewed_tier_tabs: Compensation & Loans (sensitive; moves under a Money group with the PII discipline: figures behind the viewer's existing authority, estimate states labeled, no client-side fabrication possible)
Records group: Identity & PII (with the reveal pattern), personal information, contact and emergency data
view_frequency_allocation.display_law: Zero-data renders UNKNOWN with the reason and the one-tap remediation where this surface holds the power. Salary figures that are not computed by the payroll engine render as UNKNOWN ('No salary structure configured yet') or as explicitly labeled provisional component data, never as a computed take-home. Counts render as semantic dots or numbers only when nonzero.

business_logic_rules: BR-T360-1: Payroll truth law: nothing on this surface may compute, hardcode, or universalize a salary figure. Take-home exists only when the payroll engine computed it; components render labeled-provisional or the gap renders UNKNOWN with the configure action; the vehicle for the fiction (client-side breakdown construction) is deleted, not disabled.

BR-T360-2: Statutory law: PF, DA, HRA, professional tax, and TDS render only from engine-provided values; any percentage or amount visible on the surface is traceable to its record, never to a constant in the client.

BR-T360-3: Access law: the verified matrix (requireAuth roles, canAdminister, canMutate, legal-hold restriction to SUPER_ADMIN/SCHOOL_ADMIN, teacher-assignment rules in the student domain untouched) is the only authority for tab existence and affordance visibility; the teacher themself is not an audience of this admin-side surface.

BR-T360-4: Allocation law: sub-modules live where their view frequency puts them per the approved matrix (InstantView glance, OftenViewed tabs, rarely-viewed Money/Records groups); the matrix is the record and any reallocation changes it, not the layout by feel.

BR-T360-5: One-tint law: exactly one filled tinted button per action-row state; lifecycle actions tinted or plain; offboarding plain-red; counts render as semantics only when meaningful (AD BR-AD-2 continued).

BR-T360-6: Grammar law: every component consumes the ratified design language (InsetGroupedList, StatusBadge, segmented controls, FormField, ConfirmDialog/AppModal over window.confirm/alert, materials, tabular numerals); hardcoded colors and banned palettes are CI-blocked (AD BR-AD-4 continued).

BR-T360-7: Behavior law: updateStaff, offboardStaff, confirmStaffProbation, toggleStaffLegalHold, reactivateStaff, revealStaffPii, and the PII audit-reason compose are behaviorally frozen; presentation and truth-display work only beyond the two authorized changes (photo field migration if needed, client-side payroll construction deletion).

BR-T360-8: Privacy law: AES-256 PII, the reveal-with-audit-reason pattern, S3 scoping, and DPDP consent are unchanged; staff photos ride the existing consent and scoping machinery with no new exposure.
BR-T360-9: Both-theme law: every element verified in light and dark and forced-colors at 4.5:1 (3:1 large text); a state that works in one theme only does not merge.

AC-T360-3: The AD-L6 guard hole is closed and proven: the guard's scan now covers this surface's patterns, demonstrated by a failing scratch commit and its revert; the tightened scope is recorded in design-language.md.

AC-T360-4: The shared Avatar is consumed for staff identity with photo display (and upload/replace/remove under canMutate where the schema path landed, or the recorded gap), and deterministic monogram fallback on neutral tints.

AC-T360-5: The hero carries Large Title identity, StatusBadge vocabulary only, and governed action rows: exactly one filled button per state, lifecycle confirmation through ConfirmDialog/AppModal, offboarding plain-red with the reassignment warning preserved.

AC-T360-6: The glance strip exists with employment standing, allocation tiles for teaching staff, leave summary, and attention items plus NextBestAction, deep-links each element, composes by role per the access matrix, and office_admin's scripted three questions answer from it in under a minute.

AC-T360-7: Tabs are frequency-allocated per the approved matrix with the segmented grammar; sensitive compensation sits in the Money/Records grouping; every tab and Records sub-section is URL-addressable with back navigation preserving state.
AC-T360-8: Tab and affordance existence matches the access matrix for every role; the permission test covers all roles and the excluded-role route denial.

AC-T360-9: Every tab renders on the design-language grammar; money, status, and attention colors follow color_intention_map; the CI guards pass across the surface; the window.confirm/alert pattern is gone.

AC-T360-10: Both themes and forced-colors verified at contrast; the 58,929-byte client refactor is structural only with behavior preserved and measured (parallel fetch, no new waterfalls, mobile breakpoints clean).
AC-T360-11: The non-teaching staff state renders as a real, dignified state across glance strip and Academics tab, never as a hidden gap.

AC-T360-12: journey-map.md and design-language.md carry the ratification evidence: persona proofs, the payroll truth table, guard closure, honest gaps including any deferred migration; typecheck, build, smoke green in both themes; zero new npm dependencies beyond the authorized schema work.
constraints: Zero new npm dependencies. The Avatar, segmented control, InsetGroupedList, ConfirmDialog, and metric tile patterns already exist and are consumed, not rebuilt.
Phases land in strict order T360-L0 through T360-L7, one commit series per layer. Commit prefixes: docs(design) for L0, feat(design) for L1 through L7.
The L0 baseline and allocation matrix are a review gate: the operator approves the matrix, the photo-migration decision, and the primary-action choice per action row before implementation.
Exactly the authorized logic changes: the staff photo field migration if required, and the deletion of client-side payroll construction. Any other behavioral need stops and records a gap entry.
Every phase lands with typecheck, build, and smoke render green in both theme classes. The S7 gate is permanent series law.
Do not touch payroll engines, leave engines, actions.ts lifecycle logic, routeGuards, the student PWA, or the teacher PWA self-profile; visual and truth-display work only beyond the named exceptions.
Where this spec conflicts with in-repo security or accessibility constraints, security and accessibility win; log the conflict in the commit body.
definition_of_done: Teacher 360 is done when an office admin, an HR manager, and a principal each open any staff member on the demo tenant and, in one glance, see the person's real employment standing, real teaching footprint, real leave summary, and the one action that matters, in both themes, with a real photo or an honest monogram, and tabs allocated by how people actually view them. Every salary figure on the surface comes from the payroll engine or is explicitly labeled provisional; no take-home is ever computed in a browser; professional tax is never ₹200 by constant; unconfigured payroll renders as a gap with a fix action instead of fiction. Lifecycle decisions run through governed modals, the access matrix decides what exists, the Apple grammar spans every tab with the strengthened CI guards failing any hardcoded color or banned palette, and the three persona proofs stand committed as evidence. When a staff member asks about their pay or leave, the answer comes from this surface in under a minute, and every word of it is true.
